vectors.name: musig_preparation_request
vectors.description: MuSig Preparation request: DESCRIPTOR (alias "main", FORM 0x02 wallet policy tr(musig(@0,@1)/**) over two keys [00000000/48h/1h/0h/2h]xpub and [11111111/48h/1h/0h/2h]xpub, POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a), SESSION_ID of 32 bytes of 0x51, MAX_INPUTS 2, and two MUSIG_DERIVATION entries: KEYCHAIN 0 INDEX 17, then KEYCHAIN 1 INDEX 0x7fffffff (the highest unhardened index). SESSION_ID has no LENGTH prefix.

vectors.name: musig_preparation_request_alias_only
vectors.description: MuSig Preparation request whose DESCRIPTOR carries only the alias "main": DESCRIPTOR_BODY absent (presence byte 0x00) and POR absent (presence byte 0x00). SESSION_ID of 32 bytes of 0x51, MAX_INPUTS 1, and one MUSIG_DERIVATION entry: KEYCHAIN 0 INDEX 17.

vectors.name: musig_preparation_response
vectors.description: MuSig Preparation ok response echoing SESSION_ID (32 bytes of 0x51) and MAX_INPUTS 2, with two NONCES entries for derivation KEYCHAIN 0 INDEX 17 that cover inputs 0 and 1: input 0 EXPRESSION_INDEX 0 with a 33-byte compressed PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x02 then 32 bytes of 0x11, LEAF_HASH absent (presence byte 0x00) and a 66-byte NONCE of 0x22; input 1 EXPRESSION_INDEX 1 with the same PARTICIPANT, AGGREGATE 0x03 then 32 bytes of 0x33, LEAF_HASH present (presence byte 0x01) as 32 bytes of 0x44 and a 66-byte NONCE of 0x55. NONCE has no LENGTH prefix.

vectors.name: musig_signing_request
vectors.description: MuSig Signing request: SESSION_ID of 32 bytes of 0x51, ATTEMPT_ID of 32 bytes of 0xa7, both without a LENGTH prefix, then a 19-byte PSBT holding an empty version 2 transaction.

vectors.name: musig_signing_response
vectors.description: MuSig Signing ok response echoing SESSION_ID (32 bytes of 0x51) and ATTEMPT_ID (32 bytes of 0xa7), carrying back the same 19-byte PSBT. There is no KIND byte.
